title: [review] local-fact: bearer credential — no subject (node-IID) binding
description: Security finding on viku.4. The claim set has no subject/node-IID claim and verify_local_fact has no subject parameter, so a fact is a bearer credential: any node holding another node's fact bytes can present them as its own. Sharpest for lichen:emergency_callback (attacker's emergency triggers a PSAP callback to the victim's verified number); also enables relay/priority/quota grant theft under the 8.13.1 federation model. Sibling delegation_tokens binds DELEGATE (DELEGATE_MISMATCH). The spec claim table (spec/06-security.md 8.13.1) also lacks a subject claim, so the fix likely spans spec + model. Decide with Mark whether to add a subject/IID claim.
